components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary interactive trigger for high-intent actions.
components.css: .velto-btn-primary { background: #6633EE; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(102, 51, 238, 0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .velto-btn-primary:hover { background: #5727D8; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Surface Asset Card
components.description: Standard modular card container for wallets and assets.
components.css: .velto-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #ECE8F6; border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(124, 77, 255, 0.06); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .velto-card-title { font-size: 12px; color: #7E7A9B; font-weight: 600; } .velto-card-val { font-size: 18px; color: #1E1B2E; font-weight: 800; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.northStar: Modern Soft Lavender Fintech OS with modular cards, precision financial typography, and real-time asset parity.
narrative.overview: Velto menghadirkan estetika Modern Fintech (EasyPay Soft Lavender) yang menggabungkan kemewahan violet royal dengan kanvas lembut lavender. Visual dirancang mobile-first, memprioritaskan keterbacaan angka finansial yang tajam, hierarki kartu aset yang modular, serta interaksi mikro yang presisi dan percaya diri.
keyCharacteristics: Soft Lavender Canvas (#F4F2FA) for calm, strain-free viewing
High-contrast slate text (#1E1B2E and #595574) exceeding WCAG AA standards
Clean 1px borders (#ECE8F6) avoiding crude side-tabs or dark skeuomorphic dropshadows

rules.name: The Tonal Harmony Rule
rules.body: Never use pure white backgrounds for pages; reserve white exclusively for elevated surface cards.

rules.name: The Financial Contrast Floor
rules.body: Every currency amount and interactive button text must maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background.

dos: Do use soft lavender canvas and clean white surface cards with 1px border #ECE8F6.
Do provide privacy eye masking (Rp ••••••••) on all net worth displays.
Do maintain interactive text sizes at or above 11px.
donts: Don't use thick side-tab borders (border-l-4) on rounded cards.
Don't use tacky bounce easing (animate-bounce); use smooth transitions.
Don't mix unverified business profit into personal net worth without separation.
